svg.text: English text or a PDF in, recorded Auslan signs out on a 2D avatar. Planning and animation run in the browser; the cloud only serves files.
no server work per sentence; PDFs never leave the device
stick figure drawn from motion data alone (the MP4 source video is optional)
play · pause · replay · speed 0.5–1.5× · scrub · previous/next sign · loop

gets ≈ 60 short excerpts, never the PDF
rate-limited · on any failure: offline summary
rewrites the key points in plain English
3,215 words → 4,480 motion files, avg 52 KB gz
browser fetches ONLY the signs in the sentence
excerpts (only if the AI switch is on)
done once; the app never needs the original videos
73 Node · 34 Python · 7 browser suites · library integrity check
Every step is resumable and never changes the original videos.
optional: AI summary (falls back to the offline summary on any failure)
Status: built and tested locally; NOT deployed yet. Before going public: confirm the licence of the original corpus and credit Auslan Signbank (13 letters, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0).
Capacity at 10,000 monthly users is an estimate from measured file sizes; no load test has been run. Output is automated sign matching, not verified Auslan translation.
